content: LLM browser automation is inherently non-deterministic: the same task run repeatedly can produce different navigation paths and outcomes, so single-run pass/fail is unreliable; production tools combine AI automation with mandatory human review of AI-generated tests and failure triage (real bug vs flaky). Auth flows, iframes, shadow DOM, and dynamic content remain weak points. Evaluating real websites often requires an LLM-as-judge for pass/fail verdicts, which itself introduces uncertainty.
